The expanded financial package designates $10.1 billion specifically for modernization efforts, which includes $7.2 billion allocated for common automation platforms and controller workstations alongside $2 billion dedicated to cloud computing infrastructure. Furthermore, the proposal contains $2 billion directed toward replacing and improving air traffic control towers and $18 billion intended for airport-related developments, including terminal modernizations.

Lawmakers have previously approved $12.5 billion over a five-year period in July 2025 to increase controller hiring and address technology bottlenecks within the country's airspace, which has recently faced serious safety incidents. The agency continues to rely on decades-old computer systems, including floppy disks scheduled for replacement by late 2028. Major commercial carriers have expressed support for the administration's funding appeal as officials urge Congress to approve the financial package before the end of the year.

The system vulnerabilities have caused recurring disruptions across the United States. In September, dual circuit failures and a severed fiber-optic cable in New Jersey led to widespread delays and cancellations throughout the Northeast region.

stories.title: Pakistan to Host Thirtieth ECO Council of Ministers Meeting
stories.summary:
Pakistan will host the 30th meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organization Council of Ministers in Islamabad on November 15 and 16. The Foreign Office announced that Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar will chair the high-level gathering, which will welcome foreign ministers, delegation heads, and representatives from member states, the organization secretariat, and subsidiary bodies.

Prior to the ministerial sessions, senior officials from member nations will convene to review ongoing institutional programs, evaluate subsidiary activities, and finalize the official agenda and draft documents. Operating under the theme 'Reviving Regionalism for a Resilient ECO,' Pakistan holds the organizational chairmanship for the 2026-27 term. The nation aims to utilize its leadership role to enhance regional connectivity, deepen economic partnerships, and establish itself as a primary logistics and trade hub.

Preparations for the upcoming summit follow previous high-level engagements, including the 17th ECO Summit held in Azerbaijan in July 2025, where Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif led the Pakistani delegation. During those discussions, leadership emphasized expanded intra-regional trade, energy cooperation, and sustainable transport networks aligned with long-term regional objectives.

Authorities have stressed the importance of seamless coordination to ensure the success of the Islamabad conference. The diplomatic forum is expected to address critical regional trade dynamics and foster closer economic collaboration to improve the livelihoods of citizens across member countries.

stories.title: لاہور میں شیر کے حملے سے شہری کی ہلاکت، ملزمان ضمانت پر رہا
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے کاہنہ میں ایک شہری طلحہ پر شیر کے حملے کے واقعے میں ہلاکت کے مقدمے کے حوالے سے اہم پیش رفت سامنے آئی ہے۔ اس معاملے کی سماعت جوڈیشل مجسٹریٹ قیصر ریاض نے کی، جس دوران پولیس نے گرفتار کیے گئے دونوں ملزمان فیاض احمد اور نعمان حسن کو عدالت میں پیش کیا۔

عدالت میں پیشی کے دوران ہلاک ہونے والے نوجوان کے ورثا نے اپنا بیان ریکارڈ کرایا اور عدالت میں ایک بیان حلفی بھی جمع کرایا۔ قانونی ورثا نے مؤقف اپنایا کہ انہوں نے اللہ کی رضا کی خاطر اس واقعے کے تمام ملزمان کو معاف کر دیا ہے اور انہیں کوئی کارروائی منظور نہیں۔

دوسری جانب سرکاری وکیل نے صلح نامے کی شدید مخالفت کی۔ سرکاری وکیل کا کہنا تھا کہ ملزمان نے ایک بہت سنگین جرم کیا ہے، اس لیے پولیس کو تفتیش کے لیے ملزمان کا سات روز کا جسمانی ریمانڈ دیا جانا چاہیے۔

عدالت نے سرکاری وکیل کی جانب سے ملزمان کے جسمانی ریمانڈ کی استدعا کو مسترد کر دیا۔ عدالت نے فریقین کے بیانات سننے کے بعد دونوں ملزمان کی پچاس ہزار روپے کے ضمانتی مچلکوں کے عوض ضمانت منظور کرتے ہوئے انہیں رہا کرنے کا حکم جاری کر دیا۔

stories.title: کالا باغ میں کسٹمز کی بڑی کارروائی، کروڑوں روپے کا اسمگل شدہ سامان ضبط
stories.summary:
پاکستان کسٹمز ان لینڈ انفورسمنٹ نے ایک مصدقہ خفیہ اطلاع کی بنیاد پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے کالا باغ میں واقع ایک خفیہ ڈمپنگ اسٹیشن پر چھاپہ مارا۔ اس بڑی کارروائی کے دوران حکام نے اٹھارہ کروڑ روپے مالیت کا اسمگل شدہ سامان کامیابی سے برآمد کر کے اپنی تحویل میں لے لیا ہے۔

کسٹمز کے ترجمان کے مطابق اس کارروائی میں دس ہزار کلوگرام وزنی ایسیٹیٹ ٹو کے پینتالیس بنڈلز اور چودہ سو کلوگرام تمباکو کے پچاس سے ساٹھ پارسلز ضبط کیے گئے۔ حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ یہ کلکٹریٹ کی مختصر تاریخ کی اب تک کی سب سے بڑی کارروائی ہے جس نے اسمگلنگ کے ایک بڑے نیٹ ورک کا پردہ فاش کیا ہے۔

ترجمان نے مزید بتایا کہ ڈیجیٹل انفورسمنٹ اسٹیشن پر انتہائی سخت نگرانی اور کڑی چیکنگ کی جا رہی ہے، جس کی وجہ سے اسمگلروں نے چیکنگ سے بچنے کے لیے یہ متبادل راستہ نکالا تھا۔ ملزمان نے انفورسمنٹ اسٹیشن کے قریب ہی ایک خفیہ ڈمپنگ سائٹ بنا رکھی تھی جہاں ممنوعہ سامان عارضی طور پر ذخیرہ کیا جاتا تھا تاکہ اسے بعد میں چھوٹی مقدار میں منتقل کیا جا سکے۔

کسٹمز حکام کے بروقت اقدام سے اسمگلنگ کی اس خفیہ سپلائی چین کا مکمل خاتمہ کر دیا گیا ہے۔ اس کامیاب کارروائی پر کلکٹریٹ نے پوری انفورسمنٹ ٹیم کے لیے خصوصی انعام کا بھی اعلان کیا ہے جبکہ ضبط شدہ سامان کے ساتھ قانونی کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan and Ethiopia Discuss WTO Accession and Bilateral Trade
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan and Ethiopia’s Minister of Trade and Regional Integration, Yasmin Wohabrebbi, conducted a virtual high-level meeting to advance bilateral economic ties. Discussions centered on expanding commercial cooperation, supporting Ethiopia's accession to the World Trade Organization, and resolving outstanding market access and pharmaceutical regulatory challenges.

During the talks, Jam Kamal emphasized Pakistan's dedication to strengthening economic partnerships, positioning Ethiopia as a vital gateway into East African markets. He highlighted potential areas for collaboration including agriculture, textiles, manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals, while calling for expedited resolutions regarding regulatory hurdles and direct air connectivity. Minister Wohabrebbi acknowledged Pakistan's constructive engagement and reported that 11 out of 17 bilateral market-access agreements have been finalized, requesting continued support to complete the remaining accession requirements.

Commerce Secretary Jawad Paul joined the discussions, stressing the necessity of ongoing technical coordination between relevant institutions to clear pending pharmaceutical registrations and eliminate trade bottlenecks. Both governments outlined plans to enhance institutional cooperation by convening the Joint Economic Committee and developing a strategic roadmap prior to a proposed bilateral engagement scheduled for February 2027.

Concluding the session, Jam Kamal reaffirmed that prompt implementation and decisive actions will help realize the untapped commercial potential between both nations, transforming diplomatic goodwill into practical economic outcomes.

stories.title: South Korean Foreign Minister Urges Deeper Ties and Balanced Cooperation With China
stories.summary:
South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Hyun stated that Seoul should neither harbor an unfounded fear of China's rise nor underestimate its capabilities. Speaking on Saturday following his discussions in Beijing with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi, Cho emphasized the importance of fostering mutually beneficial cooperation. This dialogue marked the first meeting between the two diplomats in approximately three months, during which they reviewed bilateral relations, peninsula issues, and ways to deliver tangible benefits to their respective populations.

The diplomatic engagement precedes the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation leaders' summit in Shenzhen, scheduled for November 18-19. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung is set to participate in the gathering and will attend a dinner hosted by Chinese President Xi Jinping alongside his wife. The regional summit is expected to convene multiple prominent global figures, including U.S. President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin, who are slated to discuss nuclear arms reductions.

Cho indicated that Seoul aims to leverage President Lee's upcoming journey to strengthen bilateral connections and expand horizontal, mutually beneficial partnerships in complementary sectors. Under President Lee, the administration has worked to repair diplomatic ties with Beijing—South Korea's primary trading partner—following strains experienced during the tenure of former president Yoon Suk Yeol, while simultaneously preserving its security alliance with the United States.

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi noted that relations have returned to appropriate pathways following interactions between leadership figures. He expressed Beijing's desire to broaden cooperation with South Korea across both traditional industries and emerging fields such as artificial intelligence and biomedicine. These diplomatic efforts highlight a concerted push by both nations to stabilize and enhance their bilateral partnership ahead of the high-stakes leaders' summit.

stories.title: Free WordPress Plugin Reprint Enables Complete Site Transfers and Testing
stories.summary:
Website administrators running WordPress now have access to a complimentary open-source utility named Reprint, designed to duplicate entire site files and databases directly onto a separate server or a personal computer. Built with PHP, the software and its command-line companion are available inside the official WordPress.org Plugin Directory. Because data moves straight to the target hardware without intermediaries, users retain complete control over the migration process.

Unlike traditional export utilities focused exclusively on individual posts or pages, Reprint duplicates an entire installation, encompassing themes, uploaded media, active plugins, and specific configuration settings. Data packets transfer in incremental segments so the original hosting environment does not require surplus storage capacity beforehand. Furthermore, paused or interrupted transfers resume automatically from the exact point of interruption instead of starting over from the beginning.

While the target copy undergoes review, the original webpage remains online and accessible to visitors. WordPress recommends verifying image rendering, form functionality, and page load speeds prior to redirecting domain traffic. Administrators can then halt fresh updates on the legacy server, perform one final synchronization, and update their domain pointers. The utility also automatically updates uniform resource locators embedded within shortcodes, custom data fields, serialized information, and content blocks.

Beyond server migrations, the software facilitates local environment testing, layout experimentation, and post-update validation. For quick evaluations, a specialized feature inside WordPress Playground permits browser-based sample duplication without manual installations. Concurrently, developers note that this rollout coincides with the deployment of WordPress 7.2 Beta 5, which authorities strictly advise limiting to designated test environments rather than production websites.

stories.title: US Aviation System Suffers Massive Breakdown Sparking Nationwide Ground Stop
stories.summary:
A major technical malfunction crippled aviation networks across the United States, forcing the Federal Aviation Administration to order an unprecedented nationwide ground stop. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy confirmed that air traffic control facilities experienced severe radar and communications instability due to data routers and switches becoming critically overloaded. Although officials managed to safely guide airborne aircraft to their destinations without completely losing contact, the disruption caused the longest aviation shutdown since the attacks of September 11, 2001.

Transportation leadership announced that airspace officially reopened during the evening hours, though departures resumed at a restricted pace. Flight tracking data from FlightRadar24 revealed that more than 6,600 flights suffered cancellations, another 8,600 faced significant delays, and thousands of additional trips scheduled for subsequent days were preemptively grounded. Major airlines including American, United, Delta, and JetBlue experienced immediate financial impacts, with stock values declining in after-hours trading. Airports nationwide saw massive crowds of passengers stranded in departure halls overnight, while carriers attempted to reposition aircraft crews and prioritize flights to international destinations and smaller cities.

Government officials emphasized that the disruption originated from mechanical issues rather than external cyber threats or artificial intelligence malfunctions, though comprehensive investigations involving the National Security Agency and the Department of Homeland Security remain ongoing. Industry insiders indicated the failure impacted critical telecommunications infrastructure managed by L3Harris Technologies that handles essential pilot-controller radio frequencies. Because the outage stemmed from government system failures rather than airline negligence, carriers are not legally obligated to compensate affected travelers.

Highlighting the incident, Secretary Duffy and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin briefed President Donald Trump on the escalating crisis. Officials pointed to an aging aviation infrastructure plagued by outdated technology and severe controller shortages as the root cause of the breakdown. The administration renewed urgent appeals to Congress for multi-billion-dollar investments to modernize the country's outdated air traffic control architecture and prevent future national disruptions.

stories.title: Iranian Revolutionary Guards Report Two Oil Tankers Hit by Strait of Hormuz Mines
stories.summary:
Iranian military authorities announced that explosions rocked two separate oil tankers after striking naval mines inside the Strait of Hormuz. According to statements released by the naval branch of Iran's Revolutionary Guards, the vessels had deactivated their radar and positioning equipment while attempting to navigate through unauthorized passages. The naval command confirmed that the blasts resulted in substantial fires, though specific vessel names and nationalities were withheld, aside from noting that one of the damaged ships classified as a supertanker.

Tensions in the crucial waterway have escalated significantly following the outbreak of armed conflict with the United States. Tehran has asserted strict control over the strategic trade route, mandating prior authorization for all passing ships and launching attacks against vessels that fail to comply. In response to these actions, the United States enforced a naval blockade surrounding Iranian ports while supplying military escorts to commercial tankers traversing the zone.

Recent weeks have witnessed multiple reported blasts and fires aboard commercial ships navigating the strait, with Iranian state media routinely attributing the incidents to naval mine impacts. Footage released by the Revolutionary Guards depicted heavy black smoke billowing from a gas-carrying vessel allegedly struck by a mine near the southern portion of the corridor. Conversely, United States military officials maintain that primary shipping channels throughout the waterway have been successfully swept and cleared of explosive mines.

stories.title: India Recalls Fast Bowler Brar and Clears Pant for New Zealand Test Series
stories.summary:
The Board of Control for Cricket in India announced official roster adjustments ahead of the upcoming two-test series against New Zealand, introducing fast bowler Gurnoor Brar to the national setup. The 26-year-old athlete will travel directly to join the test squad, meaning he will miss the final one-day international match taking place in Tauranga. Selectors decided not to name an immediate replacement for Brar, as the visiting Indian team maintains a 2-1 lead in the ongoing five-match one-day series.

Concurrently, left-arm wrist spinner Kuldeep Yadav was released from the test setup to participate in domestic cricket matches within India. Meanwhile, wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant rejoined the national team group in Wellington after successfully obtaining medical clearance regarding his physical fitness. The opening match of the two-test encounter is scheduled to commence on November 19.

The finalized test roster features Shubman Gill as captain alongside Yashasvi Jaiswal, KL Rahul, Devdutt Padikkal, Rishabh Pant, Dhruv Jurel, Ravindra Jadeja, Anshul Kamboj, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Sai Sudharsan, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Washington Sundar, Mohammed Siraj, and newly added Gurnoor Brar.

Separately, the squad assembled for the final one-day fixture comprises Shreyas Iyer leading Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Tilak Varma, Ishan Kishan, Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Auqib Nabi, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Arshdeep Singh, Kumar Kushagra, Mohammed Siraj, Yash Thakur, and Kuldeep Yadav.

stories.title: Pakistan Urges Gulf De-escalation Amid US-Iran UN Security Council Clash
stories.summary:
Pakistan called for an immediate halt to military provocations in the Gulf and renewed regional diplomacy during a United Nations Security Council meeting on November 12, 2026. Pakistan's Permanent Representative to the UN, Ambassador Syed Haider Shah, condemned attacks on Gulf countries, commercial shipping, and civilian infrastructure, while warning that threats to maritime navigation in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandab Strait endanger seafarers and worsen global energy and food insecurity. He also reaffirmed support for Saudi Arabia's sovereignty and security.

The debate featured sharply conflicting accusations between the United States and Iran over responsibility for maritime security threats. Iranian Ambassador Gholamhossein Darzi blamed unprovoked wars launched by the US and Israel on June 13, 2025, and February 28, 2026, for regional insecurity, citing 5,000 deaths in Iran and rejecting Security Council Resolution 2817. He asserted that foreign military forces are a major source of instability.

Conversely, US Ambassador Jennifer Locetta accused Iran of aggression against neighbors, firing on commercial ships, and defying the international community with missiles, drones, and unlawful mines. She cited Resolution 2817, which had 136 co-sponsors and demanded that Iran halt attacks, and criticized the Houthis for targeting Saudi infrastructure and blockading the Bab el-Mandab Strait.

Gulf Cooperation Council Secretary-General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi reported that GCC member states had faced over 7,000 Iranian missiles and drones since February 28, targeting vital infrastructure and causing casualties and environmental damage. Bahrain’s Ambassador Jamal Fares Alrowaiei welcomed mediation efforts by Oman, Qatar, and Pakistan, emphasizing that regional security requires the active participation of GCC states.

stories.title: Speedrun AI Labs Launches Free Tool to Reverse Engineer Software
stories.summary:
Sydney-based startup Speedrun AI Labs has released a free, open-source tool under an MIT license named Reverse Engineer Anything with a Self-Learning Loop. The software is designed to solve a frequent problem in automated software development, where AI agents rebuilding authorized products stall at around 80 percent completion due to a lack of clear final product requirements.

The tool establishes a structured workflow for the final 20 percent of a software rebuild. Prior to coding, the system examines the original software to create a parity testing checklist detailing required behaviors, inputs, outputs, and verification methods, which must be approved by a human operator. The system adheres to strict clean-room development rules by preventing the coding agent from accessing decompiled text from the original software.

During each review cycle, identical inputs are tested on both the original and new builds to verify matching results. A project is deemed complete only when every required feature passes two consecutive review cycles. If a build halts for two cycles or requires protected vendor system access, the agent stops and notifies the human operator. Additionally, the self-learning loop updates the core tool with new test patterns and code examples after each cycle without storing sensitive data or proprietary information.

Founder Adnan Tanveer noted the tool is intended for engineering teams permitted to recreate existing software, and warned users against copying third-party products, bypassing security, or stealing assets. The release integrates two prior agent tools and is compatible with Claude Code and OpenClaw. Speedrun AI Labs primarily develops specialized commercial agents, including a cybersecurity agent named Anton and a financial compliance agent named Joseph.

stories.title: لاہور سیشن کورٹ نے دو غیر ملکی خواتین سے زیادتی کے کیس میں ملزم کی ضمانت منظور کرلی
stories.summary:
لاہور کی سیشن کورٹ نے دو غیر ملکی خواتین سے مبینہ زیادتی اور اغواء کے ایک مقدمے میں گرفتار ملزم کی بعد از گرفتاری ضمانت منظور کر لی ہے۔ ایڈیشنل سیشن جج رفاقت علی گوندل نے اس حوالے سے درخواستِ ضمانت پر اپنا حکم نامہ جاری کیا۔

عدالت کی جانب سے جاری کردہ حکم نامے میں ملزم کو ایک لاکھ روپے کے مچلکوں کے عوض رہا کرنے کا حکم دیا گیا ہے۔ ایف آئی آر کے متن کے مطابق دونوں متاثرہ خواتین انتیس جون کو لاہور پہنچی تھیں، اور ملزم انہیں ڈیفنس میں واقع ایک گھر میں لے کر گیا تھا۔

عدالت نے اپنے فیصلے میں واضح کیا کہ نامزد ملزم پہلے ہی جیل میں قید ہے اور پولیس کو اس معاملے میں مزید تفتیش کے لیے مزید جسمانی حراست کی کوئی ضرورت درکار نہیں۔ بنیادی الزام جائے وقوعہ سے شواہد غائب کرنے سے متعلق ہے جبکہ ملزم ایف آئی آر میں نامزد نہیں تھا۔

عدالت نے تمام قانونی پہلوؤں کا جائزہ لینے کے بعد ملزم ساجد علی کی ضمانت کی درخواست منظور کرنے کا باضابطہ حکم جاری کیا۔ اس کیس کی تفتیش اور عدالت کی کارروائی کے دوران دیگر انتظامی امور بھی ساتھ ساتھ زیر بحث رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: مدھیہ پردیش میں رس گلے کی شکل میں دھماکا، ایک شخص ہلاک
stories.summary:
بھارتی ریاست مدھیہ پردیش کے ضلع ڈنڈوری میں ایک دلخراش واقعے کے دوران رس گلے کے اندر چھپایا گیا دیسی ساختہ بم پھٹنے سے 35 سالہ راجیندر بروتیا ہلاک ہو گئے۔ یہ واقعہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب راجیندر اپنے گھر کے صحن میں اہل خانہ کے ساتھ آگ تاپ رہے تھے اور ان کا پڑوسی رام بھگت سنگھ وہاں آیا۔

رام بھگت نے ہنسی مذاق کے دوران راجیندر کو ایک چھوٹی گیند نما چیز دی اور اسے دیوالی کے تہوار کے حوالے سے رس گلہ بتا کر کھانے کو کہا۔ راجیندر نے جیسے ہی اسے منہ میں رکھ کر چبایا، ایک زوردار دھماکا ہوا جس سے ان کا جبڑا پھٹ گیا اور چہرہ ناقابلِ شناخت ہو گیا۔ اہل خانہ انھیں فوری طور پر آٹو رکشے میں ڈنڈوری ضلع ہسپتال لے گئے جہاں وہ دورانِ علاج دم توڑ گئے۔

پولیس کے مطابق اس قسم کے بم کو 'سور مار بم' یا 'پگ بم' کہا جاتا ہے جو وسطی انڈیا کے دیہی علاقوں میں جنگلی سوروں کو مارنے کے لیے استعمال کیے جاتے ہیں۔ یہ دھماکا خیز مواد عموماً کھانے کی چیزوں میں چھپا کر جنگل میں رکھ دیا جاتا ہے تاکہ جانور کے چبانے پر پھٹ جائے۔

اس معاملے میں پولیس نے رام بھگت سنگھ سمیت دو افراد کو گرفتار کر لیا ہے۔ دوسرا ملزم وہ شخص ہے جسے یہ بم جنگل سے ملا تھا اور اس نے رام بھگت کو دیا تھا۔ پولیس نے بھارتیہ نیائے سنہتا کی دفعہ 105 اور ایکسپلوسِوز ایکٹ کی دفعات 3 اور 4 کے تحت مقدمہ درج کر کے تفتیش شروع کر دی ہے اور جائے وقوعہ سے ملنے والے نمونے فرانزک لیبارٹری بھجوائے جا رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: US Airspace Reopens After Major Technology Outage Causes National Groundstop
stories.summary:
The United States grounded all domestic flights for roughly four hours on Saturday following a major communications outage caused by outdated technology, creating widespread travel disruptions across the country. The nationwide groundstop stranded hundreds of thousands of passengers and marked only the second time such an alert has been issued in US airspace since the September 11 attacks, aside from a minor pilot notification system failure in January 2023.

Federal Aviation Authority officials lifted the groundstop after four hours. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that the incident stemmed from a legacy system problem involving old switches, routers, and 1980s copper lines that became overloaded. Duffy had previously asked Congress on Thursday for $30.1 billion to modernize the US Air Traffic Control System and reiterated the urgent need for these resources following the stoppage.

FlightAware data indicated that nearly 6,000 flights were canceled, including international routes, causing long lines and chaotic scenes at airports nationwide as travelers struggled to find alternative transportation or information. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin stated there was no evidence of foul play, a cyberattack, artificial intelligence involvement, or any connection to a separate Microsoft outage that affected email systems globally.

The unexpected halt left passengers facing prolonged delays and uncertainty during the busy travel period preceding the Thanksgiving holiday. While some travelers faced missed connections and altered plans, others sought out alternative routes, car rentals, or made arrangements to extend their stays with friends.

stories.title: Tesla Slips Out of Top 10 EV Brands in China
stories.summary:
Tesla has dropped out of China's top 10 New Energy Vehicle brands, according to October 2026 retail data from the CPCA passenger car association. During that month, Tesla sold 8,817 NEVs, which encompass both battery electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids. This performance follows a fourth-place ranking in September and reflects a broader downward trend in the country's market.

Market leader BYD dominated sales with 250,301 NEVs, capturing a 22.4% market share, followed by Geely with 131,708 sales and Leapmotor with 83,573. Meanwhile, Xiaomi Auto climbed to sixth place with 50,123 sales, marking the highest monthly growth among the top ten brands at 25.3% over September figures. For the first ten months of the year, Tesla’s regional sales fell 15.0% to 389,905 units, dropping the company from fifth to seventh place in year-to-date standings.

The decline coincides with a broader contraction in China's automotive sector. Total passenger car sales fell 27.1% year-on-year in October to 1,643,000 units, while NEV sales decreased by 13.7% to 1,109,000. Despite lower overall volume compared to the previous year, NEVs achieved a record 67.5% share of total passenger car retail sales in the world's largest car market.

stories.title: US Lifts Airport Ground Stop, Blames Old Equipment
stories.summary:
United States authorities lifted an hours-long nationwide ground stop at airports on Friday, attributing the severe travel disruption to outdated hardware rather than any cyberattack or Microsoft-related outage. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy announced the reopening of airspace during a late-night White House briefing, noting that traffic flow would recover gradually.

The technical failure occurred when data overloads overwhelmed legacy switches and routers built with 1980s copper lines. The incident arrived just a day after the administration formally asked Congress for $30 billion to modernize the national air traffic control system. Despite the disruption, Duffy maintained that flying remained safe for the public.

Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin firmly rejected speculation regarding a coordinated cyber assault or any connection to worldwide issues affecting Microsoft. Mullin stated that security agencies found no digital footprints or threat actor claims, though investigations remained ongoing. Both officials defended President Donald Trump, confirming he stayed in continuous communication with staff throughout the crisis.

stories.title: Massive US Flight Grounding Sparks Nationwide Travel Chaos
stories.summary:
A major communications outage caused by aging technology forced the Federal Aviation Administration to ground all US flights for approximately four hours on Saturday, creating widespread travel chaos. The rare nationwide stoppage left hundreds of thousands of passengers stranded at airports and marked only the second time such an emergency measure was implemented since the September 11 attacks, following a previous failure in January 2023.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy blamed the nationwide failure on overloaded legacy infrastructure, specifically 1980s copper lines, switches, and routers. Duffy reiterated his urgent request for Congress to approve $30.1 billion in funding to modernize the air traffic control system. FlightAware reported nearly 6,000 canceled flights, forcing frustrated travelers to seek alternative arrangements as airports faced severe congestion ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday.

Cabinet officials, including Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, confirmed there was zero evidence pointing to foul play, artificial intelligence threats, or cyberattacks. Mullin also dismissed any link to a separate technical outage that impacted Microsoft services globally earlier in the week. Stranded passengers across various airports expressed frustration over delayed updates and suddenly altered travel plans.

stories.title: Bus Conductor Sacked in Lahore After Pushing Woman
stories.summary:
A private transport company in Lahore terminated a bus conductor's employment on Friday after a video surfaced showing him pushing a woman off a vehicle. The incident, which occurred at a local terminal, quickly spread across social media and provoked widespread public outrage and swift government intervention.

Footage captured the conductor physically pushing the female commuter as she attempted to board, causing her to fall onto a parked motorcycle. In response to the backlash, Punjab Minister for Transport and Mass Transit Bilal Akbar Khan announced that Faisal Movers Group had fired the employee, identified in a disciplinary termination letter as Ali Rizwan of the BRT Lahore service. The minister condemned the behavior and apologized on behalf of the transport department.

Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz deemed simple dismissal insufficient and directed police to pursue further legal measures against the conductor. She instructed DIG Faisal Kamran to apprehend the individual and have him taken directly to the victim's residence to offer a public apology, emphasizing that transport staff are not permitted to mistreat the public.

stories.title: کراچی کے مختلف علاقوں میں رینجرز کی کارروائی، سات ملزمان گرفتار
stories.summary:
ترجمان رینجرز کے مطابق کراچی کے علاقوں سرجانی ٹاؤن اور نیو کراچی میں سیکیورٹی فورسز نے کامیاب کارروائیاں کرتے ہوئے سات ملزمان کو حراست میں لے لیا ہے۔ گرفتار ہونے والے افراد ڈکیتی اور اسٹریٹ کرائم کی متعدد وارداتوں میں ملوث بتائے گئے ہیں۔

ترجمان نے مزید بتایا کہ کارروائی کے دوران ملزمان کے قبضے سے تین غیر قانونی پستول، گولیاں، دو موٹر سائیکلیں، چودہ موبائل فونز اور نقدی برآمد کی گئی ہے۔ قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کی جانب سے اسٹریٹ کرائمز کے خلاف شہر بھر میں گشت اور کارروائیوں کا سلسلہ جاری رکھا گیا ہے۔

دوسری جانب ملک بھر کے دیگر اہم قومی امور اور خبریں بھی زیر بحث رہیں۔ پاکستان ریلوے نے اے سی خراب ہونے یا پاور پلانٹ فیل ہونے پر مسافروں کو اضافی کرایہ واپس کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ کراچی یونیورسٹی روڈ حسن اسکوائر سے نیپا تک ترقیاتی کاموں کے باعث بند کر دی گئی ہے۔

حکام کے مطابق قانون نافذ کرنے والے ادارے شہر میں امن و امان کی بحالی اور جرائم پیشہ عناصر کی سرکوبی کے لیے اپنی کارروائیاں جاری رکھے ہوئے ہیں تاکہ شہریوں کے جان و مال کا تحفظ یقینی بنایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: مریم نواز اور وفاقی وزیر کے درمیان تنازع اور سیاسی ہلچل
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے صوبے پنجاب کے سیاسی منظرنامے پر اس وقت ہلچل دیکھی جا رہی ہے جب وفاقی وزیر چوہدری سالک کے ایک بیان کے بعد حکومتی صفوں میں اختلافات سامنے آئے۔ چوہدری سالک نے ایک نجی چینل کے انٹرویو میں دعویٰ کیا تھا کہ پنجاب میں کرپشن سے الماریاں بھری ہوئی ہیں، جس کے بعد وزیر اعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے ان کے اس بیان کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے انھیں ہرجانے کا نوٹس جاری کیا۔

وزیر اعلیٰ مریم نواز نے پنڈدادخان اور اٹک میں تقاریر کے دوران اس معاملے پر سخت ردِعمل ظاہر کیا۔ انھوں نے چوہدری سالک کا نام لیے بغیر تنقید کی کہ اگر حکومت اتنی ہی کرپٹ ہے اور اعتراض ہے تو وزراء استعفیٰ دے کر گھر کیوں نہیں چلے جاتے۔ مریم نواز کا کہنا تھا کہ الیکشن قریب آ رہا ہے اور کچھ لوگ اپنی اگلی ارینجمنٹس اور متبادل نظام کے تحت بیانیہ بنا رہے ہیں۔

اس معاملے پر وفاقی وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف اور سابق نگران وزیر اعلیٰ محسن نقوی نے بھی بیانات دیے ہیں۔ خواجہ آصف نے کہا کہ ان کی سیاسی سمجھ کے مطابق ایک متبادل نظام بنانے کی تیاری کی جا رہی ہے تاکہ موجودہ حکومت کو بدنام کیا جا سکے، جس میں کچھ سرمایہ دار بھی شامل ہیں۔ محسن نقوی نے لاہور میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ کرپشن پورے پاکستان میں موجود ہے جسے ختم کرنا حکومت کی ذمہ داری ہے۔

مسلم لیگ ن کے رہنما رانا ثنا اللہ نے اس حوالے سے یاد دلایا کہ 2018 کے الیکشن سے پہلے بھی کرپشن کا شور مچایا گیا تھا لیکن کسی الزام کا ثبوت نہیں دیا گیا تھا۔ نوٹس ملنے کے باوجود چوہدری سالک اپنے بیان پر قائم ہیں اور ان کا کہنا ہے کہ پنجاب حکومت نے ان کی سکیورٹی بھی واپس لے لی ہے۔

سینیئر صحافیوں سہیل وڑائچ اور سلمان غنی کے مطابق یہ تنازع دونوں فریقین کے مفاد میں نہیں ہے اور مارچ تک اس سیٹ اپ میں کوئی تبدیلی نہیں آئے گی۔ تجزیہ کاروں کا کہنا ہے کہ اس کشمکش کے باوجود بالاآخر معاملات طے پا جائیں گے کیونکہ یہ نظام کے مفاد میں بہتر ہے۔

stories.title: امریکہ میں فضائی نظام کی خرابی کے بعد پروازیں چار گھنٹے معطل رہنے کے بعد بحাল
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں فضائی نظام میں اچانک شدید تعطل کے بعد پروازوں کی بحالی کا عمل شروع کر دیا گیا ہے۔ نائن الیون کے بعد پہلی بار ملک بھر میں تمام پروازیں روکنے کا حکم دیا گیا تھا جس کے باعث فضائی آپریشن تقریبا چار گھنٹے تک مکمل معطل رہا۔ وائٹ ہاؤس میں منعقدہ ایک نیوز بریفنگ کے دوران امریکی حکام نے تصدیق کی کہ اس نظامی تعطل کا تعلق کسی بھی قسم کے سائبر حملے یا مائیکروسافٹ کی خرابی سے نہیں تھا۔

امریکی وزیرِ ٹرانسپورٹ شان ڈفی اور ہوم لینڈ سکیورٹی کے سیکریٹری مارک وین مولن نے مشترکہ پریس کانفرنس میں بتایا کہ یہ خرابی فرسودہ اور پرانے آلات پر اضافی دباؤ کی وجہ سے پیدا ہوئی۔ وزیرِ ٹرانسپورٹ نے تسلیم کیا کہ نقل و حمل کا موجودہ نظام پرانا ہو چکا ہے اور اسے جدید بنانے کے لیے فوری طور پر کانگریس کی حمایت درکار ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ مواصلاتی رابطہ وقفے وقفے سے منقطع ہونے کی وجہ سے حکام کو مجبورا فضائی حدود بند کرنے کا انتہائی قدم اٹھانا پڑا۔

حکام نے واضح کیا کہ فضائی ٹریفک کنٹرول کے مراکز اور ٹریکونز اب دوبارہ فعال ہو چکے ہیں، لیکن اس تعطل کے اثرات سے نمٹنے میں مزید چند دن لگ سکتے ہیں۔ آسٹریلیا کے سڈنی ایئرپورٹ سمیت مختلف مقامات پر امریکہ جانے والی پروازیں روکی گئیں یا تاخیر کا شکار ہوئیں۔ دریں اثنا، یونائیٹڈ ایئرلائنز اور امریکن ایئرلائنز سمیت دیگر فضائی کمپنیوں نے مسافروں کو اپنی پروازوں کی تازہ ترین معلومات کے لیے ویب سائٹ چیک کرنے اور متعلقہ اداروں سے رابطے میں رہنے کی ہدایت جاری کی ہے۔

stories.title: Sindh Government Announces One-Window Facility for Builders at ABAD House
stories.summary:
Sindh Minister for Local Government Syed Nasir Hussain Shah announced that a dedicated one-window operation office will be established at ABAD House in Karachi. Inaugurating the three-day ABAD In-House Exhibition on Friday, Mr Shah emphasized the provincial administration's dedication to fostering a favorable business climate and driving investment within the construction sector.

The newly planned facility aims to resolve industry hurdles swiftly by streamlining approval procedures and aiding builders and developers. To achieve this, the Sindh Building Control Authority director general and government officials are collaborating closely alongside ongoing digitalization efforts. Mr Shah noted that more than 150 road infrastructure projects are currently underway throughout Sindh to boost regional development.

Highlighting international recognition, the minister urged stakeholders to concentrate on economic growth and keeping capital within the country rather than transferring funds abroad. He added that the administration is working to enhance governance and refine the Provincial Finance Commission and National Finance Commission frameworks to better support economic initiatives.

Speaking as the guest of honour, Sindh Governor Nihal Hashmi encouraged participating companies to target global markets to strengthen Pakistan's economy through higher exports. He also highlighted that the federal administration, led by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, remains actively engaged in allocating financial resources for ongoing infrastructure development across Karachi.

stories.title: England manager Tuchel confident ahead of clash against unbeaten Spain
stories.summary:
England manager Thomas Tuchel has expressed strong confidence that his squad is fully prepared to halt Spain's formidable 43-match unbeaten run when the two teams meet in Madrid on Sunday. Although the fixture carries limited consequences beyond positioning for a favorable Nations League quarter-final in March, Tuchel views the match as a crucial benchmark for evaluating his team's true competitive limits.

Spain enters the contest following a long period without defeat, while England aims to reverse the outcome of their previous encounter in September, where Spain secured a 3-2 victory at Wembley despite a missed penalty by Harry Kane. Tuchel stressed the importance of maintaining an aggressive, physical mindset and imposing England's strengths on the pitch from the opening whistle.

Addressing off-field concerns, Tuchel also touched upon historical issues of racism involving fixtures in Spain and recent disciplinary actions taken against the Spanish federation by governing bodies. The German manager stated his firm opposition to discrimination, noting that strict protocols are in place for officials and players, and emphasized that any necessary responses should be delivered through performance during the match.

England arrives in Madrid fresh off a 2-1 victory over Croatia at Wembley, adding momentum to Tuchel's squad as they prepare to test themselves against the reigning world and European champions on foreign soil.

stories.title: لاہور میں خواجہ سراؤں کی ٹرین ڈرائیور کیبن میں سفر پر مقدمہ
stories.summary:
لاہور میں دو خواجہ سراؤں کے ٹرین کے ڈرائیور کیبن میں سفر کرنے کی ایک ویڈیو منظرِ عام پر آئی ہے۔ اس ویڈیو کے سامنے آنے کے بعد ریلوے حکام کی جانب سے فوری کارروائی عمل میں لائی گئی ہے۔

واقعے کا نوٹس لیتے ہوئے متعلقہ ٹرین کے ڈرائیور اور اسسٹنٹ ٹرین ڈرائیور کے خلاف باضابطہ طور پر مقدمہ درج کر لیا گیا ہے۔ حکام کی جانب سے اس پورے واقعے کی مزید تحقیقات کا آغاز بھی کر دیا گیا ہے تاکہ تمام حقائق کا تعین کیا جا سکے۔

اس کے علاوہ ملک بھر میں دیگر انتظامی اور حکومتی امور بھی زیرِ بحث رہے ہیں۔ پاکستان ریلوے نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ اے سی خراب ہونے یا پاور پلانٹ فیل ہونے کی صورت میں مسافروں کو اضافی کرایہ واپس کیا جائے گا۔

کراچی میں ترقیاتی کاموں کے باعث یونیورسٹی روڈ حسن اسکوائر سے نیپا تک بند کر دی گئی ہے جبکہ پشاور پولیس نے نجی جرگوں پر پابندی عائد کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ مزید برآں، سرکاری افسران کے اثاثوں کے ڈیجیٹل گوشوارے جمع کرانے کی آخری تاریخ میں بھی توسیع کر دی گئی ہے۔

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz ready for ATP Finals despite stomach illness
stories.summary:
Spanish tennis star Carlos Alcaraz had to cut short a training session on centre court in Turin on Friday due to a sudden stomach upset that prevented him from eating breakfast. Despite the abrupt end to his practice in front of spectators, the player expressed optimism, stating that his condition was continuously improving as he prepared for the season-ending ATP Finals.

Alcaraz enters the tournament seeking his first ATP Finals title in his fourth appearance, having finished as the runner-up last year. Following a four-month absence earlier due to a wrist injury sustained in late August, he has secured titles in Tokyo, Vienna, and Paris, alongside reaching the US Open quarter-finals where he was defeated by Ben Shelton. Feeling mentally fresh, the athlete believes he is arriving in optimal conditions.

The tournament also brings a unique dynamic for Alcaraz, who ended his successful partnership with long-time coach Juan Carlos Ferrero at the conclusion of the previous season. Ferrero, who guided him to six Grand Slam titles and 24 tour-level trophies, is now coaching Ben Shelton and will be present in Turin. Alcaraz acknowledged that seeing his former mentor will feel unusual after such a long time apart, but he expressed excitement about catching up.

The event holds high stakes for the sport as players gather for the year-end championship. Alcaraz remains eager to tackle any challenges ahead and aims to claim the elusive crown that narrowly escaped him in the previous iteration of the prestigious competition.

stories.title: Heavy Snowfall Strands Passengers and Transport at Khunjerab Pass
stories.summary:
Severe winter weather conditions continued to disrupt Gilgit-Baltistan on Friday, leaving a significant number of travellers, tourists, and commercial vehicles trapped at the Khunjerab Pass along the Pakistan-China border. Continuous heavy snowfall and rain created hazardous conditions, rendering the Karakoram Highway extremely slippery and prompting safety warnings from local law enforcement.

The hazardous road surface caused three shipping containers to skid off the highway, while a Chinese cargo vehicle overturned near Khunjerab Top. Local residents and Khunjerab Security Police personnel swiftly rescued the unhurt driver. Gilgit-Baltistan Minister for Tourism Naiknaam Karim, who was among those stranded, criticized the lack of proactive snow-clearing operations on the Pakistani section of the route, noting that the Chinese side of the pass had already been cleared.

Authorities from the Gilgit-Baltistan police urged the public to avoid unnecessary travel and recommended calling helpline 15 for updates before attempting journeys. Stranded travellers at the high-altitude pass, situated above 15,000 feet, voiced concerns over severe cold and potential oxygen scarcity. Meanwhile, separate rainfall triggered a landslide at Hopper Pari, completely cutting off traffic along the Ghizer-Shandur Road.

The disruption highlights ongoing infrastructure vulnerabilities during extreme weather events in northern Pakistan, severely impacting cross-border trade and regional mobility. Travelers and transport operators continue to face delays as authorities coordinate emergency responses to clear blocked mountain passes and highways.

stories.title: Asad Mehmood Fails to Appear Before NAB for Second Time
stories.summary:
Asad Mehmood, son of JUI-F chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman, ignored a second summons issued by the National Accountability Bureau (NAB) on Friday. The former federal minister failed to present himself before the bureau's investigation team regarding an ongoing inquiry into alleged recruitment irregularities during his tenure as communications minister in 2022-23.

According to bureau insiders, the NAB Rawalpindi and Islamabad Regional Office had previously issued an initial notice on November 10, which Mr Mehmood also bypassed. Following his non-compliance with the second directive, anti-corruption officials indicated that a third notice would soon be dispatched. Continued failure to respond could result in punitive measures, including potential arrest by the watchdog.

The investigation centers on allegations of procedural violations involving 4,252 appointments made at Pakistan Post while the former minister held office under the Pakistan Democratic Movement coalition government. NAB procedures typically involve issuing up to three sequential notices before taking enforcement action against non-compliant respondents.

The ongoing case forms part of a broader string of anti-corruption inquiries directed at political figures and their associates. The escalation of notices underscores the accountability body's intent to compel cooperation regarding public sector appointments made during the previous administration.

stories.title: امریکی وزیر خارجہ مارکو روبیو کا عالمی فوجداری عدالت کو سخت انتباہ
stories.summary:
امریکی وزیر خارجہ مارکو روبیو نے عالمی فوجداری عدالت (آئی سی سی) پر شدید تنقید کرتے ہوئے واضح کیا ہے کہ امریکا اپنی خودمختاری اور قومی مفادات کے منافی کسی بھی بین الاقوامی ادارے کے فیصلوں کو ہرگز تسلیم نہیں کرے گا۔ انہوں نے خبردار کیا کہ اگر اس عدالت نے امریکی شہریوں یا فوجی عملے کے خلاف دیے گئے فیصلوں کو نافذ کرنے کی کوئی بھی کوشش کی، تو واشنگٹن اس کا جواب طاقت کے ذریعے دے گا۔

واشنگٹن میں فیڈرلسٹ سوسائٹی کے قومی اجلاس سے خطاب کے دوران مارکو روبیو نے بین الاقوامی قوانین اور عالمی عدالت کے دائرہ کار پر کھل کر بات کی۔ انہوں نے قدیم روم کے معروف جنرل پومپی کا قول دہراتے ہوئے آئی سی سی کو تنبیہ کی کہ وہ امریکی شہریوں پر اپنے احکامات مسلط کرنے سے باز رہے اور خبردار کیا کہ تلواریں اٹھانے والوں کو قوانین کا حوالہ دینا بند کر دینا چاہیے۔

رائٹرز اور اے ایف پی کے مطابق، اس خطاب میں امریکی وزیر خارجہ نے واشنگٹن کے اس عزم کا اعادہ کیا کہ وہ اپنے شہریوں کے تحفظ کے لیے کسی بھی بیرونی قانونی دباؤ کو قبول نہیں کرے گا۔ اس سے قبل عالمی فوجداری عدالت کی جانب سے افغانستان میں امریکی افواج کے مبینہ جرائم کی تحقیقات بند کیے جانے کا معاملہ بھی سامنے آ چکا ہے، جبکہ روبیو کے اس سخت بیان سے بین الاقوامی سطح پر قانونی اداروں اور امریکا کے درمیان تعلقات میں تناؤ مزید ظاہر ہوتا ہے۔

stories.title: ڈیوڈ وارنر کا کرکٹ آسٹریلیا پر سینڈ پیپر اسکینڈل میں پردہ پوشی کا الزام
stories.summary:
آسٹریلیا کے سابق اوپنر ڈیوڈ وارنر نے سنہ 2018 کے سینڈ پیپر اسکینڈل کی تحقیقات پر کرکٹ آسٹریلیا کو شدید تنقید کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے پردہ پوشی کا سنگین الزام عائد کیا ہے۔ سوشل میڈیا پر اپنے بیان میں وارنر نے دعویٰ کیا کہ ابتدائی تحقیقات کے دوران فاسٹ بولرز جوش ہیزل ووڈ، مچل اسٹارک اور نیتھن لائن کے انٹرویوز تک نہیں کیے گئے تھے۔ انہوں نے سوال اٹھایا کہ اس عمل کے بعد یہ مؤقف کیسے درست مانا جا سکتا ہے کہ بولرز گیند سے چھیڑ چھاڑ سے لاعلم تھے۔

وارنر کا کہنا تھا کہ ایسا محسوس ہوتا ہے کہ تحقیقات شروع ہونے سے پہلے ہی چند مخصوص کھلاڑیوں کو ذمہ دار ٹھہرانے کا فیصلہ کر لیا گیا تھا اور آج بھی حقائق کے برعکس وہی مؤقف برقرار رکھا جا رہا ہے۔ اس تنازع میں اس وقت مزید شدت آئی جب کپتان پیٹ کمنز نے عثمان خواجہ کے الزامات کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے سینڈ پیپر کے استعمال سے لاعلمی ظاہر کی۔ وارنر نے کمنز کے بیان پر ناراضی کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے عثمان خواجہ کی کتاب میں بیان کردہ حقائق کی مکمل حمایت کی۔

دوسری جانب کرکٹ آسٹریلیا کے ترجمان نے موقف اختیار کیا کہ اس وقت تمام کھلاڑیوں کو اپنا مؤقف پیش کرنے کا بھرپور موقع دیا گیا تھا اور گزرے آٹھ برسوں میں بھی نئے شواہد سامنے لانے کی مکمل گنجائش موجود رہی ہے، تاہم ترجمان نے تینوں بولرز کے انٹرویوز سے متعلق براہ راست کوئی جواب نہیں دیا۔

اس معاملے پر کرکٹ آسٹریلیا کے چیف ایگزیکٹو ٹوڈ گرین برگ نے تحقیقات کو دوبارہ سے کھولنے کی ضرورت یکسر مسترد کر دی ہے۔ اس تازہ تنازعے کے نتیجے میں آسٹریلوی کرکٹ کے سابق کھلاڑیوں کے مابین پائے جانے والے اختلافات بھی کھل کر سامنے آ گئے ہیں اور یہ معاملہ کرکٹ حلقوں میں موضوعِ بحث بنا ہوا ہے۔

stories.title: محسن نقوی دیے گئے اسائمنٹ پر کام کرتے ہیں، ایاز صادق کا بیان
stories.summary:
اسپیکر قومی اسمبلی سردار ایاز صادق نے کہا ہے کہ وفاقی وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی اپنے ذمے لگائے گئے اسائمنٹ پر بھرپور طریقے سے کام کرتے ہیں۔ لاہور میں منعقدہ ایک تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ ملک میں ہر وزیر اپنی وزارت کے امور چلا رہا ہے اور حکومت میں ہر ایک کا اپنا الگ اور مقررہ کردار ہے۔

آئندہ کسی بھی آئینی ترمیم کے حوالے سے بات کرتے ہوئے ایاز صادق کا کہنا تھا کہ وہ یہ نہیں پوچھتے کہ کوئی ترمیم آ رہی ہے یا نہیں، البتہ جب ترمیم سامنے آئے گی تب اس کا علم ہو جائے گا۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ آئینی ترمیم کے حوالے سے ان کا اپنا ذاتی کام صرف اور صرف سہولت فراہم کرنا ہے اور وہ اس ترمیم کو اچھا یا برا قرار نہیں دیں گے۔

اسپیکر قومی اسمبلی نے تقریب سے خطاب کے دوران اس عزم کا اظہار بھی کیا کہ وہ پارلیمانی امور کو آئین اور قانون کے مطابق چلانے کے لیے ہمیشہ اپنا کردار ادا کرتے رہیں گے۔ انہوں نے ملکی سیاسی و انتظامی صورتحال پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے اراکین کابینہ کی کارکردگی اور حکومتی امور کے حوالے سے اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کیا۔

اس تقریب میں ملکی سیاسی امور، آئینی ترامب اور سرکاری ذمہ داریوں کے حوالے سے مختلف امور زیر بحث آئے جن پر ایاز صادق نے تفصیلی روشنی ڈالی۔ تقریب کے شرکاء نے اسپیکر قومی اسمبلی کے خطاب کو غور سے سنا اور ان کے ان خیالات کو میڈیا میں بھی کونس لیج کیا گیا۔

stories.title: Balochistan Assembly Resolves to Make Basic Arabic Compulsory in Schools
stories.summary:
The Balochistan Assembly unanimously passed a resolution on Friday recommending the inclusion of basic Arabic as a mandatory subject in all government-run primary schools across the province. JUI-F Member of Provincial Assembly Shahida Rauf introduced the motion, emphasizing that early instruction in the language would help students comprehend commonly used Quranic terminology and expressions.

The approved resolution outlines a structured framework, advocating for a simplified, grade-wise curriculum focusing on fundamental vocabulary and basic grammar. It also underscores the necessity of deploying qualified educators, supplying adequate textbooks, and establishing robust monitoring mechanisms. Implementation is proposed through a phased rollout tailored to the developmental capacities and educational needs of young learners.

During the assembly session, MPA Dr Abdul Malik Baloch drew attention to previous legislative efforts enacted in 2013 to advance education in regional mother languages. He urged the provincial government to ensure that earlier educational mandates are enforced alongside the newly recommended Arabic instruction initiative.

The unanimous adoption reflects broad legislative support for integrating religious and linguistic studies into foundational schooling throughout the province. Officials hope the structured phased program will improve students' comprehension skills from an early age under careful institutional oversight.

stories.title: US Federal Aviation Administration Lifts Nationwide Flight Ground Stop
stories.summary:
The US Federal Aviation Administration lifted a nationwide ground stop on Friday after a communications failure at air traffic control centers caused severe airport chaos. This incident triggered the longest nationwide flight shutdown since the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks, highlighting deep strain on the American air traffic system.

According to FlightRadar24, the disruption resulted in more than 4,700 canceled flights and 10,000 delays on Friday, with another 700 cancellations already logged for Saturday. Aviation analysts indicated that airlines would likely need several days to fully restore their operational schedules following the grounding, which lasted over four hours.

The Department of Homeland Security stated that there was no indication of a cyberattack causing the outage. The event represents the latest and most dramatic breakdown for a US air traffic control network that has struggled with equipment failures, communications issues, controller shortages, and aging infrastructure.

Prior to this event, the only other nationwide ground stop since the September 11 attacks occurred in January 2023, when domestic departures were halted for approximately 90 minutes. The situation underscores ongoing vulnerabilities within the nation's critical aviation infrastructure.

stories.title: UNDP Chief Warns of Doubled Costs Without Immediate El Nino Action
stories.summary:
United Nations Development Programme chief Alexander De Croo warned delegates on Friday at the COP31 talks in Turkey that failing to act immediately against the impacts of El Nino will double future financial costs. Speaking in the resort city of Antalya, De Croo stated that hedging against El Nino requires $36 billion currently, whereas inaction will drive expenses up to $73 billion.

El Nino warms Pacific Ocean waters every two to seven years, altering global wind patterns and rainfall, and this exceptionally strong cycle has already damaged economies worldwide. De Croo urged institutions like the International Monetary Fund and wealthy nations to support vulnerable developing countries, noting that vulnerable regions have endured compounding crises including the Covid-19 pandemic, the war in Ukraine, the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, and high financing costs.

A UN report highlighted estimates from the African Development Bank of $10 billion to $20 billion in regional damage, while the UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean projected cumulative GDP losses of at least two percent over three years, pushing 4.8 million people into poverty. De Croo pressed for immediate adaptation investments across 47 partner nations.

Meanwhile, on the sidelines of the Antalya summit, sources revealed that China has decided against hosting the 2028 COP33 climate talks. Beijing's withdrawal leaves the opportunity open for another Asia-Pacific nation to organize the event, following India's withdrawal of its offer in April and previous expressions of interest by South Korea.

stories.title: India Adds Gurnoor Brar to Test Squad, Releases Kuldeep Yadav
stories.summary:
The Board of Control for Cricket in India announced on Saturday that fast bowler Gurnoor Brar has been added to the national test squad for the upcoming two-match series against New Zealand. Concurrently, spinner Kuldeep Yadav was released from the setup so he could return to play domestic cricket in India.

The 26-year-old Brar will travel directly to join the test team in New Zealand, making him unavailable for the fifth and final one-day international in Tauranga. India holds a 2-1 lead in the five-match ODI series and has chosen not to name a direct replacement for Brar. Meanwhile, wicketkeeper-batter Rishabh Pant has successfully joined the squad in Wellington following a recent fitness clearance.

The upcoming two-test series between India and New Zealand is scheduled to begin on November 19. The announced test squad features Shubman Gill as captain, alongside teammates Yashasvi Jaiswal, KL Rahul, Devdutt Padikkal, Rishabh Pant, Dhruv Jurel, Ravindra Jadeja, Anshul Kamboj, Jasprit Bumrah, Prasidh Krishna, Akash Deep, Sai Sudharsan, Nitish Kumar Reddy, Washington Sundar, Mohammed Siraj, and the newly added Brar.

Separately, the roster for the fifth ODI includes Shreyas Iyer as captain, Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, Tilak Varma, Ishan Kishan, Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Auqib Nabi, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Arshdeep Singh, Kumar Kushagra, Mohammed Siraj, Yash Thakur, and Kuldeep Yadav before his departure for domestic duties.

stories.title: یوٹیوبر رابعہ فیصل کا پہلا ڈرامہ سامنے آگیا، شوبز انڈسٹری میں انٹری
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے معروف اور مقبول ترین یوٹیوب چینل ’سسٹرولوجی‘ سے ملک بھر میں شہرت حاصل کرنے والی سوشل میڈیا انفلوئنسر رابعہ فیصل نے اب شوبز انڈسٹری میں باقاعدہ قدم رکھ دیا ہے۔ یہ فیملی پانچ بہنوں پر مشتمل ہے جنہوں نے اپنے ڈیجیٹل سفر کا آغاز یوٹیوب سے کیا تھا، تاہم اب تمام بہنیں سوشل میڈیا کے ساتھ ساتھ اپنے انفرادی کیریئر پر بھی خصوصی توجہ دے رہی ہیں۔

رابعہ فیصل ایک نجی ٹی وی چینل کے آنے والے نئے ڈرامے ’بے حس‘ کے ذریعے اداکاری کی دنیا میں اپنا ڈیبیو کرنے جا رہی ہیں۔ متعلقہ ٹی وی چینل کی جانب سے اس ڈرامے کا پہلا باضابطہ پوسٹر جاری کر دیا گیا ہے جس میں اداکارہ رابعہ فیصل کی پہلی جھلک بھی مداحوں کو دکھائی گئی ہے۔

رابعہ فیصل کی اس نئی شوبز انٹری پر ان کی بڑی بہنوں اقرا کنول اور حرا فیصل نے انتہائی خوشی کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے رابعہ کے اس نئے سفر پر نیک خواہشات کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے بھرپور حمایت کا یقین دلایا ہے۔

دوسری جانب سوشل میڈیا اور ڈرامہ انڈسٹری کے مداحوں کی جانب سے بھی رابعہ کو اداکاری کی دنیا میں قدم رکھنے پر مبارکبادیں دی جا رہی ہیں۔ مداح ان کے اس پہلے ٹی وی ڈرامے کا بے صبری سے انتظار کر رہے ہیں اور اس نئے پروجیکٹ کے حوالے سے سوشل میڈیا پر خاصی چہ مگوئیاں جاری ہیں۔

stories.title: Senator Sherry Rehman Urges Credible Financing Framework at COP31 Talks
stories.summary:
Senator Sherry Rehman called for the COP31 conference in Antalya to move past mere declarations and establish a credible, accessible, and equitable climate financing framework. In a statement issued on Friday, she warned that climate-vulnerable nations like Pakistan are trapped in a dangerous cycle of disasters, debt, and declining development opportunities.

Rehman expressed appreciation for Turkiye's leadership in hosting COP31 amidst geopolitical divisions and climate emergencies, hoping the event translates climate solidarity into concrete financial outcomes. She criticized the contradiction between climate goals and continued fossil fuel support, pointing out that global fossil fuel subsidies reach approximately $7 trillion while vulnerable nations struggle to fund basic adaptation and recovery.

Highlighting alarming global temperature trajectories, Rehman noted that current policies point toward roughly 2.7 degrees centigrade of warming by the end of the century, pushing the 1.5 degrees centigrade threshold out of reach. She warned that such warming would have devastating consequences for countries like Pakistan, undermining food security, water availability, and economic stability.

Recalling national impacts, Rehman noted that the 2022 floods affected 33 million people and caused about $30 billion in damages and losses, while agricultural losses from 2025 floods reached $1 billion. She emphasized that Pakistan is demanding climate justice and financial accountability rather than charity.

stories.title: Yemeni Government Forces Fortify Defenses Around Aden Amid Advance
stories.summary:
Yemeni military officials reported that the internationally recognised government is fortifying positions on the outskirts of Aden province, which hosts their de facto capital. The defensive measures come as Houthi forces capture strategic hilltops and advance eastward following the collapse of a 2022 truce.

Violence has escalated significantly since the Saudi-backed government lost control of the Red Sea coastline along the Bab al-Mandab strait in September. The Houthis have consolidated gains near the Red Sea and moved closer to the Gulf of Aden, seizing strategic hilltops in the Al-Madaribah wal Ara district overlooking Aden province.

A military official confirmed receiving high-level directives to establish military fortifications, including stacking sandbags and digging tunnels, west and north of Aden Governorate as threats draw nearer. Government forces have repeatedly attempted to retake the Red Sea coast without success, resulting in dozens of casualties on both sides over recent days.

Additionally, a field officer stated that the Houthis captured the Al-Maqatirah region, home to the main gateway road to Taiz, which has been under Houthi siege for weeks. This capture complicates government efforts to retake Taiz and facilitates further Houthi advances toward the Gulf of Aden coast.

stories.title: WASA Lahore Launches Advanced Smart Water Metering System in Johar Town
stories.summary:
The Water and Sanitation Agency (WASA) Lahore has formally launched a smart water metering system in Johar Town as part of an urban resource management and digital transformation initiative. During the initial phase, 1,000 advanced ultrasonic smart water meters were successfully installed and made operational, moving the utility away from traditional flat-rate billing toward consumption-based management.

Following the Johar Town pilot project, WASA Lahore plans to deploy an additional 10,000 smart meters over the next three months to promote responsible and sustainable water use across the city. WASA Lahore Managing Director Ghufran Ahmed visited Johar Town to inspect the new infrastructure and centralized device management dashboard, where Director Planning and Evaluation Mudassar Javed briefed him on telemetry networks, real-time data streaming, and system performance parameters.

The new infrastructure bills consumers strictly based on actual water usage to foster conservation and accountability. WASA has integrated the system with the Punjab WASA mobile app, allowing residents to monitor daily consumption trends, review meter reading histories, and download water bills directly from their mobile devices.

WASA leadership highlighted that the ultrasonic meters are effective in preventing resource loss, stopping water wastage, deterring unauthorized water theft, and eliminating illegal connections. Furthermore, real-time data feeds allow for more accurate assessments of fluctuating urban water demand and supply patterns.

stories.title: UHS Launches Province-Wide Digital Platform to Monitor Medical Education
stories.summary:
The University of Health Sciences has introduced a province-wide digital system named PRIME to integrate medical and health professions education, clinical training, and competency assessments. Provincial Minister for Specialized Healthcare and Medical Education Khawaja Salman Rafique inaugurated the platform at a ceremony in Lahore. The initiative aims to enhance transparency, accountability, and quality assurance through digital oversight.

The initial phase of the portal will cover approximately 3,300 postgraduate medical and dental trainees in MS, MD, and MDS programs across 33 training institutions in Punjab, alongside around 1,100 registered supervisors. The system replaces traditional paper logbooks with electronic records detailing clinical cases, attendance, rotations, research, and workplace assessments. Institutional dashboards will allow the university to monitor training standards and address shortcomings.

Minister Khawaja Salman Rafique noted that improving healthcare is a primary objective of Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif's administration. He emphasized that modern medical facilities require a well-trained workforce capable of making sound clinical decisions rather than merely increasing the number of medical degrees. UHS Vice Chancellor Maj Gen Prof. Sohail Sabir stated that future phases will expand the platform to undergraduate MBBS and BDS programs, house-job training, and eventually nursing, pharmacy, and allied health sciences.

Director of Postgraduate Studies Prof. Muhammad Asif Naveed explained that the portal features continuous internal evaluations, workplace assessments such as Mini-CEX and DOPS, and a learning management system. The platform matters because it enables administrators to track progress and implement corrective measures during training rather than depending entirely on final examinations, ensuring a more competent healthcare workforce across roughly 230 supervised institutions in Punjab.

stories.title: Goalkeeper Jesus Owono Suspended for 12 Matches After Fatal Collision
stories.summary:
Spanish football authorities have handed FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono a 12-match suspension. The disciplinary committee of the Spanish football federation imposed the ban following a fatal on-field collision involving the Equatorial Guinea international and Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel.

The tragic incident occurred on November 2 during a second-division match when Owono rushed into midfield to clear an aerial ball and collided heavily with De Miguel. The Tenerife player received initial medical treatment on the pitch before being transported to a hospital and placed in the intensive care unit.

Although De Miguel's condition was initially reported as stable, it rapidly deteriorated, and he passed away on November 3. The tragedy has triggered routine legal procedures under Spanish law, which mandates a judicial inquiry and a police investigation into all non-natural deaths to examine potential involuntary manslaughter.

Despite the ongoing police scrutiny, prosecutors have indicated that formal criminal proceedings against the goalkeeper are unlikely. The suspension serves as the immediate sporting penalty enforced by the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee following the second-tier match.

stories.title: PIDE Roundtable Urges Export-Oriented Approach to Regional Trade Agreements
stories.summary:
Speakers at a roundtable conference in Islamabad organized by the Pakistan Institute of Development Economics called for a strategic shift toward an export-oriented approach in the country's trade agreements. Titled "From Signing to Exporting: Exploring the Export-Promoting Role of Trade Agreements," the event featured experts from organizations such as the WTO, Economic Advisory Group, Pakistan Business Council, and APTMA. The discussion focused on how imports from regional trade agreement partners have outpaced exports since 2000.

Dr. Amjad Masood, Chief of Research and Director at CTLI, presented report findings indicating that each dollar of imports from RTA partners is currently matched by only about 20 cents of exports. The presented report advocates for a framework focused on export-driven negotiations, industrial policy alignment, demand-based partner selection, sanitary and phytosanitary access alongside tariff reductions, and key performance indicator reviews at the Ministry of Commerce. Former WTO ambassador Dr. Ahmad noted that Pakistan's agreements have largely underperformed, with the Turkiye pact covering only two percent of trade.

Participants discussed various systemic hurdles contributing to the trade lag. Dr. Vaqar Ahmed suggested treating free trade agreement offers as steps toward unilateral liberalization, while Sarrah Javad of APTMA pointed out that secured market access frequently excludes tariff lines relevant to actual exporters. Javed Kureishi of the Pakistan Business Council emphasized the need for designated leads and follow-up protocols for reviews. Other speakers, including Dr. Zafar Mahmood and Dr. Adil Nakhoda, stressed that Pakistan must translate preferential access into global competitiveness by improving economic diplomacy and integrating into global value chains.

The conference highlights a critical need for simpler customs procedures, paperless processes, and inclusive reforms to overcome trade facilitation delays. Reforming these trade agreements matters because it could unlock significant export potential, improve business competitiveness globally, and address the widening trade imbalances stemming from regional pacts established over the past two decades.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Sharif Praises Overseas Pakistanis for Strengthening UK Relations
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif commended the role of overseas Pakistanis in enhancing bilateral relations between Pakistan and the United Kingdom during a ceremony at the British High Commission in Islamabad. Celebrating the 77th birthday of Britain's King Charles III, Sharif noted that nearly two million British citizens of Pakistani origin serve as an essential bridge and make valuable contributions across various sectors in the UK. He also lauded King Charles III for a public service career that inspires millions across the Commonwealth.

During the event, Sharif expressed gratitude to the British government and British High Commissioner Jane Marriott for their condolences regarding recent terrorist attacks in Islamabad and other regions of Pakistan. Reaffirming national resolve, he stated that Pakistan remains determined to eliminate terrorism with the backing of its armed forces and people. He recalled past interactions with the British monarch and expressed appreciation for High Commissioner Marriott's efforts in facilitating the resumption of Pakistan International Airlines flights to Manchester, while extending an invitation to King Charles III and Queen Camilla to visit Pakistan.

British High Commissioner Jane Marriott reciprocated condolences and reaffirmed the UK's support for Pakistan, highlighting the strong bilateral relationship. She noted that bilateral trade has reached £5.5 billion annually and pointed out that 15 British Members of Parliament of Pakistani origin currently serve in the UK Parliament, including Shabana Mahmood, the first Muslim woman appointed as the United Kingdom's Home Secretary.

The event underscores the multifaceted partnership between the two nations, driven by diaspora engagement, growing economic ties, and diplomatic cooperation. Recognizing these contributions matters for maintaining robust diplomatic channels, fostering economic collaboration, and addressing shared global security and counter-terrorism objectives.

stories.title: PHMA Praises Rs300 Billion SME Export Finance Reserve for FY2026-27
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Hosiery Manufacturers & Exporters Association (PHMA) has officially welcomed the government's decision to allocate Rs300 billion exclusively for small and medium enterprises (SMEs). This dedicated funding falls under the Pak EXIM-administered Export Finance Scheme (E-EFS) for the fiscal year 2026-27. PHMA Chairman Syed Zia Alamdar Hussain stated that this move highlights the administration's strong dedication to bolstering the SME sector, enhancing access to budget-friendly financing, and driving export-led economic expansion.

Highlighting leadership contributions, the chairman expressed gratitude toward Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, Federal Minister for Finance and Revenue Senator Muhammad Aurangzeb, the Ministry of Finance, and Pak EXIM Bank for enabling this crucial support for SME exporters. He pointed out that securing affordable working capital has historically been a major obstacle for smaller-scale exporters who strive to scale up their production capacities, fulfill fresh export orders, and maintain competitiveness in global markets.

According to the PHMA chief, dedicating the entire Rs300 billion fund to qualified SMEs will supply targeted financial backing and boost their market competitiveness. He emphasized that SMEs play a vital role in the country's industrial and export landscape by driving employment creation, industrial diversification, entrepreneurship, and sustainable economic progress. Furthermore, the initiative is expected to motivate smaller businesses to venture into export markets, scale their operations, and contribute more effectively to national foreign exchange reserves.

To ensure maximum impact, Hussain urged participating banks to process financial requests transparently, swiftly, and without hassle, allowing funds to reach authentic SME exporters without unwarranted delays. He also called on financial institutions to clearly outline eligibility criteria and assist deserving enterprises in utilizing the scheme. Concluding his remarks, Hussain reaffirmed the PHMA's dedication to collaborating closely with state institutions to promote national textile, hosiery, and knitwear exports while elevating the country's standing globally.

stories.title: UN Urges Safe Navigation as Maritime Attacks Rise in Middle East
stories.summary:
A United Nations official warned the UN Security Council virtually on Friday that escalating tensions and persistent attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and Bab al-Mandab pose severe risks to international peace, regional stability, and the global economy. Khaled Khiari, assistant secretary-general for the Middle East, Asia and the Pacific, briefed the Council at Bahrain's request, emphasizing that civilian vessels and commercial cargo ships must never be treated as military targets.

According to data from the International Maritime Organisation, October recorded the highest monthly volume of incidents against commercial shipping since February, with 134 confirmed incidents documented across the Strait of Hormuz and broader Middle East maritime areas as of November 11. These disruptions have resulted in the deaths of 25 seafarers, alongside numerous injuries and missing personnel, leaving many ships and crews stranded inside the Gulf for months. Khiari noted that current maritime arrangements remain costly, unsafe, and unpredictable, driving up energy, transportation, and insurance costs while threatening global food security and fertilizer shipments.

While welcoming a lack of major military exchanges between the United States and Iran since early September and the revival of diplomatic talks in Doha, Khiari cautioned that regional energy export recoveries should not mask the underlying risks. He urged parties to negotiate in good faith and prevent maritime chokepoints from being leveraged as instruments of coercion. Separately, Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi, secretary general of the Gulf Cooperation Council, delivered a unified Gulf stance rejecting any infringement on member sovereignty and called on the Council to take decisive action against ongoing threats from Iran and the Houthis.

stories.title: Punjab Drafts Food Fortification Bill 2026 to Combat Malnutrition
stories.summary:
The Punjab government has drafted the Punjab Food Fortification Bill 2026, which introduces mandatory fortification for flour, ghee, cooking oil, and salt. The proposed legislation aims to tackle child malnutrition, stunting, and nutritional deficiencies among women across the province. Provincial Minister for Food Safety and Consumer Protection, Salma Butt, announced that the draft was prepared for approval following instructions from Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif.

The minister revealed these details during a meeting she chaired, which included key attendees such as Secretary of Food Safety Dr. Kiran Khurshid, Director General of Food Safety Anwar Jappa, Punjab Food Authority Director General Raja Mansoor, and other senior officials. Butt noted that 27.3 percent of children under five in Punjab currently suffer from stunted growth, reflecting an improvement from 31.5 percent in 2017 following various government interventions. Additionally, alarming levels of iron and zinc deficiencies among women aged 15 to 49 necessitated the introduction of this new regulatory framework.

Under the guidelines of the proposed bill, compliance with fortification requirements for flour, ghee, cooking oil, and salt will be compulsory for producers. Manufacturers who fail to register in accordance with the Food Authority Act will face penalties including up to three months in prison and fines reaching Rs1 million. Furthermore, obstructing food safety officers or failing to adhere to fortification standards can lead to imprisonment of up to six months and fines as high as Rs2 million.

The legislation also requires all manufacturers and importers to conduct daily internal checks, rapid testing, and strict quality assurance protocols. Stringent laboratory testing and production monitoring will be implemented to safeguard the quality of micronutrient premixes utilized in food processing. Butt stressed that fully cooperating with food safety officers and supplying accurate data will remain a legal obligation for all relevant organizations striving to secure a healthier province.

stories.title: FBR Denies Written Tests Amid Training Needs Assessment Controversy
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) is scheduled to hold a training needs assessment in Lahore for Inland Revenue officials in Grade-17 and above. This follows the completion of similar evaluations in Islamabad and Karachi aimed at measuring the sales tax and income tax capabilities of tax officers. A senior FBR official addressed recent misconceptions regarding the capability assessment previously conducted in Karachi.

FBR representatives firmly rejected claims that written exams had taken place during the Karachi evaluation. The official explained that the exercise was merely a routine 'training needs assessment' conducted by the bureau based on identified requirements, stressing that it should not be treated as a formal written test of tax personnel. This clarification follows a viral social media report claiming that out of tested officers, only a small fraction were deemed capable of independently adjudicating tax cases.

Dismissing the circulated figures as inauthentic, the FBR official questioned the validity of the social media report, pointing out the absence of official signatures or stamps and suggesting it could easily be generated via artificial intelligence tools like Claude AI. Nevertheless, the leaked report sparked intense debates regarding the legality, transparency, methodology, and underlying purposes of surprise competency checks administered to FBR officers recruited through competitive examinations.

Critics have raised questions concerning whether such limited assessments can legally justify questioning the competence of career civil servants under existing service rules, or if they are intended to push a narrative of institutional failure that favors external consultants. As calls grow for an independent review of the evaluation framework, transparency regarding AI involvement, and fair appeal mechanisms, affected officers continue to express worries over professional reputational damage and institutional morale.

stories.title: Tanker Collides with Paddle Wheeler in New Orleans, Hospitalising 32
stories.summary:
A luxury passenger paddle wheeler docked on the Mississippi River in New Orleans was struck by a tanker ship on Friday, causing the cruise vessel to capsize and sink as people scrambled to escape. Harbour personnel, firefighters, and bystanders rushed to rescue individuals thrown into the water, resulting in all passengers and crew being accounted for.

New Orleans Mayor Helena Moreno described the outcome as a miracle, confirming that 32 passengers from the American Cruise Lines vessel, the American Heritage, were hospitalised with non-critical injuries. Approximately 180 to 190 passengers and crew members were aboard the ship when the accident occurred around midday. The vessel, built in 2015, has a standard capacity of 150 passengers.

Harbour Police Chief Melanie Montroll stated that about 87 passengers managed to disembark safely before the ship overturned. According to officials, the tanker, named the Atlantic Asphalt, apparently experienced a steering failure and lost control before hitting the docked cruise ship. Coast Guard Captain Melanie Burnham noted that the exact cause of the mishap remains under active investigation.

Following the collision, the US Coast Guard implemented a temporary closure of all river traffic in the immediate vicinity of the accident. American Cruise Lines released a statement expressing deep concern for everyone involved and confirming that the company is fully coordinating its response with the Coast Guard and local authorities.

stories.title: مرکزی مسلم لیگ کا مریم نواز کو قانونی نوٹس، معافی کا مطالبہ
stories.summary:
مرکزی مسلم لیگ نے وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز کی جانب سے پارٹی پر بے بنیاد اور سنگین الزامات عائد کرنے پر انہیں باقاعدہ ایک قانونی نوٹس بھجوا دیا ہے۔ پارٹی کے صدر خالد مسعود سندھو کی ہدایات پر یہ نوٹس ایڈووکیٹ محمد عامر حبیب کی وساطت سے جاری کیا گیا ہے، جس میں مطالبہ کیا گیا ہے کہ وزیراعلیٰ 7 روز کے اندر اپنے الزامات پر معافی مانگیں۔

قانونی نوٹس کے متن کے مطابق مریم نواز نے اپنے ذاتی سوشل میڈیا اکاؤنٹ ایکس اور الیکٹرانک میڈیا کے مختلف ذرائع پر مرکزی مسلم لیگ کو ’غیر قانونی پارٹی‘ اور ’دہشت گرد پارٹی‘ قرار دیا تھا۔ نوٹس میں کہا گیا ہے کہ مرکزی مسلم لیگ الیکشن کمیشن آف پاکستان میں ایک باقاعدہ رجسٹرڈ سیاسی جماعت ہے جس نے سنہ 2024 کے عام انتخابات میں اپنے انتخابی نشان ’کرسی‘ پر حصہ لیا تھا، جبکہ 8 نومبر 2026 کو حلقہ این اے 77 گوجرانوالہ کے ضمنی انتخاب میں یہ جماعت دوسری بڑی قوت کے طور پر ابھری تھی۔

نوٹس میں مریم نواز سے یہ بھی مطالبہ کیا گیا ہے کہ وہ سات روز کے اندر سوشل میڈیا سے تمام ہتک آمیز اور بے بنیاد الزامات پر مبنی پوسٹس فوری طور پر ڈیلیٹ کریں۔ اس کے علاوہ ان سے تحریری یقین دہانی مانگی گئی ہے کہ وہ آئندہ اس نوعیت کے توہین آمیز الزامات نہ تو دوبارہ دہرائیں گی، نہ ہی شائع کریں گی اور نہ ہی کسی دوسرے ذریعے سے ان کی تشہیر کریں گی۔

مرکزی مسلم لیگ کی جانب سے واضح کیا گیا ہے کہ اگر مقررہ مدت یعنی 7 روز کے اندر معافی نہ مانگی گئی تو پارٹی کے پاس قانون کا دروازہ کھٹکھٹانے اور قانون کے مطابق سخت کارروائی عمل میں لانے کا مکمل حق محفوظ رہتا ہے۔ اس قانونی نوٹس کے بعد سیاسی حلقوں میں ہلچل مچ گئی ہے اور معاملہ زیر بحث ہے۔

stories.title: CERP Urges Data-Driven Research to Improve Public and Private Policy
stories.summary:
Data-based research serves as an essential foundation for enhancing the quality of decision-making and policymaking to stimulate growth across both public and private sectors, according to Mehar Tiwana, Director Learning Hub at the Centre for Economic Research in Pakistan (CERP).
